notes:
Account background: Large custodial fintech; heavy regulatory requirements (KYC/AML records). Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to avoid egress and to integrate with internal SIEM and KMS. Prefer customer-managed keys and retention controls.

Recent timeline and interactions:
- 2024-10-01: Intro call (AE Ravi + SE Daniel) - general platform fit, high-level interest in private VPC.
- 2024-10-08: SE deep-dive - reviewed VPC architecture slide deck, asked about per-route audit logging. Action: SE to provide log schema examples. (drive:/deals/thornbridge/siem_schema_proposal.xlsx)
- 2024-10-15: Security review (with InfoSec lead Priya Shah). Fireflies: ff-2024-10-15-6b9d1c. Priya: "We need immutable access logs and export to Splunk/QRadar with minimal transformation."
- 2024-10-22: KMS gating discussion - customer requires HSM-backed CMKs, rotation policy, and KMS audit events forwarded to their KMS audit stream. Raised INF-3421.
- 2024-11-05: Network/ops call - discussed SIEM ingestion: preferred syslog over TLS or HTTPS push to collector; asked for event schema mapping to their fields (timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, model, prompt_hash, token_count, response_status, src_ipv4, dst_instance). Fireflies: ff-2024-11-05-3f2a8e.

Audit logging / SIEM requirements captured:
- SIEM export formats: NDJSON over HTTPS, syslog/tcp-tls to customer collector, and S3 drop (parquet) as fallback.
- Schema keys requested: iso8601 timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, api_key_hash (pseudonymized), model_id, sequence_len_in, sequence_len_out, prompt_hash (pseudonymized), response_status (200/4xx/5xx), latency_ms, tokens_charged, src_ipv4, instance_id, route, rollout_variant.
- Access logs: authentication events (token issued, token revoked), admin panel access, configuration changes, model rollouts, and canary failover events.
- Retention: Legal requests 7 years for certain PII-adjacent metadata; security willing to accept 1 year for raw prompts if pseudonymized, 7 years for metadata-only logs. Need redact/pseudonymization controls documented.
- Integrity: Prefer append-only storage with write-once options and MD5/SHA256 checksums; support for signed log blocks for tamper evidence.
- KMS integration: Bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via HSM-backed CMK; Redwood to publish key usage audit events to customer audit stream; support key rotation without breaking historical log decryptability.
- Data residency: All logs for EU customers must stay in eu-1 region; for Thornbridge (US HQ) they want logs stored in us-east-1 but mirrored to their central SIEM in us-west-2.

Quotes / customer color:
- Priya (InfoSec): "We need explicit field mappings so our DLP can detect when PII might leak into prompts. SIEM ingestion must be lossless and schema-stable for 2+ years."
- CTO (Elliot Mercer): "If Redwood can provide transparent key management hooks and push logs to our Splunk, we can move forward with a pilot."

- Document pseudonymization approach for prompt_hash + api_key_hash and retention controls for raw prompt storage.
- Validate KMS rotation story: will rotated keys still allow decrypting historical log archives?

- Send legal the model for log retention and redaction controls; request security checklist sign-off meeting week of 2024-11-18.
